title: EmailRule
description: An email processing rule - supports both pattern-based (match) and condition-based rules

id.description: Unique rule identifier. System rules prefixed with 'sys-'

action.description: Action to take when rule matches. Priority: track_as_task > review > archive

type.description: DEPRECATED: Use 'action' instead. Kept for backwards compatibility with user rules.

condition.description: Natural language condition for matching (for system rules and advanced user rules)
